import json, checker
from checker import Checker, Function, shape, join
from language import load

orig_block = Checker.block
def traced_block(self, body, env, facts):
    # show the loop's approximation of 'f' each fixpoint round
    print("  loop round env:", {n: (("writes=%s" % sorted(t.writes)) if isinstance(t, Function) else sorted(t))
                                for n, t in env.items() if n in ('f','g')})
    return orig_block(self, body, env, facts)
Checker.block = traced_block

p = load(open('witness.json').read())
c = checker.Checker(p)
env = {}
facts = {n: __import__('checker').scalar(__import__('language').kind(d['value'])) for n, d in p['cells'].items()}
c.block(p['body'], env, facts)
f = env['f']
print("\nchecker's type for f after the loop:")
print("  outer writes :", sorted(f.writes))
print("  result writes:", sorted(f.result.writes), "  <-- should include 'd'")
print("  facts for cell d after everything:", sorted(facts['d']), " (checker still believes int)")
EOF
